hero.alt: A row of shop storefronts on St. Armands Circle in Sarasota, including Circle Books and Loving Touches, under a Mediterranean-revival roofline with a palm tree in the foreground
hero.caption: Storefronts along St. Armands Circle, John Ringling's shopping-and-dining roundabout.
hero.author: Ebyabe
hero.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP. The adaptation is released under the same licence.
hero.verification: Part of Ebyabe's numbered "St Armands Circle" historic-district series, showing the Circle's own storefronts and Mediterranean-revival architecture. The guide's previous hero was generic stock not showing the real Circle; this is a real, identifiable photo of the place itself. No identifiable people in frame.

Columbia Restaurant.note: Commons has many photos of the original Ybor City Columbia location, which is a different building and not this Sarasota outpost; no Commons photo found for the St. Armands location itself. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): Openverse searched "Columbia Restaurant St Armands Circle" — zero results; still only the unrelated Ybor City original appears in CC-licensed sources.

Café on St. Armands.note: No Commons photo found for this restaurant; Wayfind's inventory carries only a Google Places photo. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): Openverse searched "Café on St. Armands" — the one result was an unrelated Paris street-clock photo; no photo of this restaurant exists on Openverse.

Shore.note: No Commons photo found for this restaurant; the app resolves its photo via a live Google Places name search. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): "Shore" alone is too generic a word to search meaningfully on Openverse; searched "St Armands Circle Sarasota restaurants" instead as a broader net — zero relevant results. No photo of this restaurant exists on Openverse.
